title: Chronos
description: Chronos portrays the evolution of the solar system, from the Big Bang to human space exploration, as an interactive educational timeline.

detail.subtitle: Interactive history of the solar system
detail.fullDescription: Chronos is an interactive platform that presents key milestones in the history of the solar system in a visual, educational and immersive way.
process: JavaScript was used to build interactive animations and animated scrolling, including dynamic size transitions and light/dark state changes.
Figma supported the design and prototyping of the visual narrative and animated scenes.
Bootstrap was used to ensure responsive layouts and consistency across devices.

title: Dashboard RResearch
description: Dashboard orientado a analise de dados com foco em leitura rapida.

detail.subtitle: Leitura de dados e decisao
detail.fullDescription: Projeto centrado em visualizacao e organizacao de informacao, com tres vistas principais no conjunto atual de imagens.
process: Definicao dos indicadores e blocos de informacao.
Desenho da hierarquia visual do dashboard.
Ajustes de contraste, espacamento e legibilidade.
Implementacao dos componentes e funcionalidades com queries à base de dados da hasura.

title: Design Sprint
description: Processo completo de sprint: pesquisa, ideacao, prototipo e testes.

detail.subtitle: Do problema ao prototipo
detail.fullDescription: Colecao de artefactos de sprint incluindo entrevistas, user journey, sketching, prototipos e validacao.
process: Mapeamento do problema e formulacao de How Might We.
Sintese da pesquisa com user journey e insights.
Criacao de prototipos low fidelity.
Iteracao com base em testes e feedback.
Criação de prototipos high fidelity

title: Framed Story
description: Experiencia digital com versoes desktop e mobile.

detail.subtitle: Narrativa visual do portfolio fotográfico
detail.fullDescription: Projeto com foco em composicao visual, com um portfolio fotografico executado até ao presente momento
process: Definicao da narrativa e estrutura de conteudo.
Design dos layouts principais para desktop.
Adaptacao para mobile com foco em usabilidade.
Implementação do design com React.

title: Opposti
description: High-fidelity prototype in Affinity Design for a modern cafe and ice cream shop, extending the in-store experience into digital ordering and workshop booking.

detail.subtitle: Digital extension of a cafe experience
detail.fullDescription: The platform was designed to support online orders and workshop registrations while preserving the character of the physical space through a clean and intuitive interface.
process: Online ordering flow lets users browse the menu and order coffee and ice cream quickly.
Workshop registration allows users to enroll in in-house coffee and culinary workshops.
The UI was designed for clear navigation and frictionless actions from discovery to checkout.

title: Pedro Henrique
description: Projeto visual com exploracao desktop e mobile de um site de arquitetura.

detail.subtitle: Layouts e iteracoes do projeto
detail.fullDescription: Implementação de um layout para o site de arquitetura, com foco em responsividade e usabilidade.
process: Organizacao dos requisitos e referencias visuais.
Adaptacao mobile com foco em continuidade.
Implementacao dos componentes e funcionalidades com dados estaticos

title: Planetarium Pursuit
description: Interactive narrative platform commissioned by Planetario do Porto for creating and publishing story-driven educational scenarios.

detail.subtitle: Storytelling and educational interaction
detail.fullDescription: Administrators can build narrative scenarios with characters, objects and backgrounds, creating game-like educational experiences for visitors.
process: PHP manages scenario creation, user interactions and dynamic content rendering.
MySQL stores stories, assets and metadata for fast retrieval during interaction.
JavaScript supports front-end interactions such as drag-and-drop and object placement.

title: SARA
description: User-centered platform to simplify audiovisual equipment requisition for students and faculty and inventory workflows for administrators.

detail.subtitle: Equipment requisition with user-centered design
detail.fullDescription: The project combined UX research and iterative prototyping to reduce friction in request, approval and inventory management flows within a university context.
process: User-centered design focused on intuitive flows for students, teachers and SARA staff.
Design thinking guided research, prototyping and iteration based on stakeholder feedback.
Laravel provided a secure and scalable foundation with authentication, authorization and data management.
implementation with react and tailwind para uma interface responsiva e moderna, com foco em usabilidade e clareza de informação.

title: Ser+
description: Projeto Ser Mais com foco na divulgação das atividades que ocorrem na univerdidade de aveiro fora do contexto das aulas

detail.subtitle: Direcao visual e conceito da marca
detail.fullDescription: Projeto de direcao visual e conceito para a marca Ser+, com foco na comunicacao das atividades culturais e de lazer da universidade de aveiro, com reconhecimento de quem nelas participa.
process: Analise de contexto e objetivos dos stakeholders.
Construcao do conceito da aplicação
Aplicacao do conceito em formato digital.
Criação de prototipos de alta fidelidade
Investigação junto dos utilizadores

title: Top Indian Movies
description: Movie database platform inspired by IMDb, built with PHP and MySQL, with ratings, favorites and admin management tools.

detail.subtitle: Movie discovery, ratings and administration
detail.fullDescription: The platform allows users to explore movies, manage favorite lists and rate titles, while administrators maintain users, movies and genres.
process: PHP and MySQL power search and retrieval of detailed movie records.
Users can save favorites and ratings through database-backed interactions.
Admin roles manage users, movies and genres with secured authorization flows.
